scope: Read-only CPU analysis after root confirmed process exit; full original deterministic action prefixes, no API/GPU/trajectory alteration.

process_evidence.completion_evidence: two recorded sequences and run_manifest written; task writers closed before extension shutdown
process_evidence.failure_stage: Python interpreter garbage collection after normal Isaac extension shutdown

shutdown_caveat: Exit139 at Python interpreter garbage collection after Isaac extension shutdown, reported by root and process_exit.json. Completion/readability is evaluated separately; this is not exit0 evidence.
invocation_integration_caveat: This run used the new physical task/facade with probes importing the OLD GenericRobotTools symbol from the new module. The import was corrected only after this run; the new ProjectV11RobotTools wrapper is not GPU-validated by this run.
source_commit_caveat: Run performed on working-tree Project_v1_1 additions. The release contract captures physical dependency hashes; current source may differ after run (shutdown/import fixes). No final released commit is inferred.

metrics.position: World actual TCP minus current-time Cartesian reference, not final target at action start.
metrics.orientation: SO(3) angle, WXYZ source; radians converted to degrees.
metrics.speed: Control-endpoint pose difference divided by actual elapsed simulation time. Not a physics-substep instantaneous maximum.
metrics.FK: Model FK residual of applied planned joint command vs target; machine-size model consistency is not actual robot precision.
metrics.steps: Actual source receipt control/physics counter differences; initialization excluded from per-action counts.
metrics.boundary: Two deterministic sequences only, not broad workspace precision or fine insertion accuracy; no full grasp/insertion/release executed.
